name: WHO emergencies
summary: WHO's Bundibugyo Ebola emergency of international concern, declared 17 May, remains in force; no new PHEIC found
state: WHO declared the Bundibugyo Ebola epidemic a public health emergency of international concern on 17 May, and its Emergency Committee said in August that it remains one (WHO). UKHSA's outbreaks report for the week to 8 Nov, published 12 Nov, records the PHEIC as continuing and lists no other new emergency. Searches to 14 Nov found no new PHEIC in the past 30 days and no pandemic emergency, so the level stays Watch.
for_you: Travellers to DR Congo and neighbouring countries should follow FCDO travel advice and UKHSA guidance. UKHSA rates the risk to the UK population as low.
rubric_hit: A PHEIC in effect (Bundibugyo Ebola, declared 17 May) = Watch; no new PHEIC in past 30 days

rubric.alert: A new PHEIC declared in the past 30 days, or a pandemic emergency declared.
rubric.watch: A PHEIC in effect, or an IHR Emergency Committee convened.
rubric.normal: No PHEIC in effect other than long-running polio.
